[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Charles Francis McPherson Glasgow was born on 17 April 1839 in England, United Kingdom, the son of [[Glasgow-3785|George Mark Glasgow]] and [[Herkimer-106|Ann Mary Herkimer]]. He died on 14 November 1916 in Oak Grove, Clackamas, Oregon, United States.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3785]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The 1916 Oregon death-record index explicitly associates Charles Francis McPherson Glasgow with George Mark Glasgow. The unusual names and coherent 1839 English birth under the artillery father strongly identify the selected father; the 1910 Ahalt/Barnett census is irrelevant.

Selected Glasgow-3785 fatherhood of Glasgow-3786; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Read the original Oregon death parent fields and an English baptism.
